integrity: The comparison is proved directly from the two source root equations. The unique crossing follows from exact factorization of their difference, monotonicity follows from root-level implicit differentiation, and the endpoint laws follow from exact changes of variables and Taylor expansion. Numerical values are used only as a consistency check, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result compares only the two specific sharp radius functions defined by Corollaries 2.1 and 2.2 of the cited preprint. It does not assert pointwise domination between the two generalized Bohr functionals for every harmonic mapping, and it does not classify sharp radii for arbitrary generalized bases.
title: The two sharp close-to-convex harmonic Bohr radii cross exactly once
